FN-J0ETFF-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 177
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Jim Carns
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/12/2023
House Bill 177as reported by the Committee on Commerce and Small Business provides for the
conversion of certain municipal waterworks boards to regional boards, which could increase or decrease
the obligations of any converted boards by an undetermined amount dependent difference in the
membership of the regional boards and the original board and the associated travel and salary costs. This
bill could also increase the obligations of any such converted board by an undetermined amount
dependent on the cost of employing a chief executive office and having its financial statements
reviewed.

FN-J0ETFF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 177
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Jim Carns
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 177as introduced provides for the conversion of certain municipal waterworks boards to
regional boards, which would decrease obligations of any converted boards by an estimated $96,000
annually by providing that regional board members serve without compensation, instead of receiving up
to $1,000 per month in compensation, as provided by current law. This bill could further decrease the
obligations of any converted by an undetermined amount dependent due to the decrease in membership
of the board from eight members to seven and the corresponding decrease in related reimbursement for
necessary expenses of board-related costs. This bill could increase the obligations of any such converted
board by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of employing a chief executive office and
having its financial statements reviewed.
